goal: Review error handling for swallowed errors, retries, timeouts, cleanup and useful messages.
use: Review error handling for swallowed errors, retries, timeouts, cleanup and useful messages. Use when code handles failures from I/O, networks or external services.

steps.note: Read the call paths. Open the code that calls external services, files, databases and queues, and list each call that can fail.
Check swallowed errors. Flag empty catch blocks, errors logged and then ignored, and errors that turn into a success result.
Check retries. Retries need a limit, a backoff and a check that the operation is safe to repeat.
Check timeouts. Every external call needs a timeout.
Check cleanup. Resources must be released on every failure path, normally by a language construct that does this.
Report. List each finding as file and line, with severity, the problem and the fix.
